name: v2-engine
description: Unified QA engine: shared explore/critique/annotate core + mobile (mobile-mcp) and web (Playwright MCP) drivers.

scripts.test-app:mobile: node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env mobile/explore.mjs && { node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env mobile/critique.mjs; node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env mobile/design.mjs; node mobile/annotate.mjs; node mobile/report.mjs; }
scripts.test-app:web: node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env web/explore.mjs && { node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env web/critique.mjs; node --env-file=../v2-mobile-tester/spike/.env web/design.mjs; node web/annotate.mjs; node web/report.mjs; }
